title: PJM Reliability Backstop Procurement results — a pay-as-bid average price for new PJM supply, not a clearing price, landing ~2 weeks before the 2029/30 BRA
source: EST: derived by tariff arithmetic from PJM's own FERC filing in docket ER26-3380-000 (accession 20260731-5214, filed 2026-07-31), fetched direct from pjm.com/pjmfiles/directory/etariff/FercDockets/9806/20260731-er26-3380-000.pdf on 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200) and text-extracted locally. The filing publishes NO absolute results date — it publishes a RELATIVE schedule (Proposed Tariff, Attachment DD, section 18.4): the offer submission window 'is planned to open upon Commission acceptance of this submittal, close three weeks after, and the subsequent clearing and selection process will take place thereafter and conclude six weeks following the closing of the offer submission window.' PJM states it 'requests that the Commission issue an order on this filing and make this proposal effective by no later than September 29, 2026' and that 'Upon Commission acceptance of this filing without modification, PJM intends to commence the RBP on September 30, 2026.' Open 2026-09-30 + 3 weeks = 2026-10-21 close; + 6 weeks = 2026-12-02. Both press-reported dates fall exactly out of that arithmetic (utilitydive.com/news/pjm-backstop-capacity-auction-ferc-data-centers/826792/, 'bid window September 30 - October 21', 'results due by December 2'). Filed estimate for a stronger reason than the taxonomy: the date is EXPRESSLY CONDITIONAL and slips day-for-day with the FERC order. PJM's own footnote — 'The RBP procurement window will open if and when a Commission order [accepts the] framework... absent significant revisions or developments' — and its Part V — 'Should the Commission require modifications to the proposed RBP as detailed in this filing, PJM may need to delay the commencement of the RBP beyond September 30, 2026' — make the whole chain contingent. As of 2026-09-08 no FERC order accepting ER26-3380 was found on any search run, and the PJM Independent Market Monitor filed a protest (monitoringanalytics.com/filings/2026/IMM_Protest_Docket_No_ER26-3380_20260821.pdf, fetched direct 2026-09-08, HTTP 200) asking the Commission to REJECT the filing outright as 'unjust and unreasonable'. pjm.com/markets-and-operations/rpm publishes no RBP schedule, so the confirmed `PJM:` prefix (pjm.com auction schedule) does not apply. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: Canonical file written 2026-09-08 by this event's own never-assessed initial research, per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md ('When your own event was proposed by others'). Supersedes proposals/pjm-reliability-backstop-results-2026-12-02.from-pjm-capacity-auction-2026-12.json, which discovered this event during the 2026-09-08 pjm-capacity-auction-2026-12 adjacency sweep; that proposal stays where it is and goes inert. TITLE AND FRAMING AMENDED against the proposal on primary-source evidence the proposal did not have. The proposal called this 'the first PJM capacity print able to clear above the $325 collar cap'. PJM's filing shows there is no clearing price to speak of: the RBP is PAY-AS-BID ('a pay-as-bid structure, unlike a single clearing price structure, relies on individual clearing prices rather than a single clearing price'), the $555/MW-day UCAP figure is a MW-WEIGHTED-AVERAGE budget constraint on levelized procurement cost across all Delivery Years — not a hard cap on any individual offer — and $555 is precisely Point 1 of the VRR curve for the 2028/29 BRA, i.e. the uncollared cap the collar suppressed, not a new higher willingness to pay. The published number will be an average of accepted asks levelized over a 15-year term with commercial-operation dates out to 2032-06-01; it is not comparable to a one-year RPM clearing price. Impact medium and symbols empty on the proposing ledger's grounds, re-verified: none of the nine tracked names is an IPP, the exposed names (VST/CEG/TLN/NRG) live in docs/research/ai-energy-constraint.md rather than on the tracked roster, and no house playbook is keyed to a capacity procurement. Estimate — nothing here licenses a date-keyed entry. Full assessment: docs/research/events/pjm-reliability-backstop-results-2026-12-02.md
